items.hed: The Houston Texans are coming off their blowout win over the Indianapolis Colts and remain on an extended break before their Week 12 home matchup against the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29
items.insight: C.J. Stroud threw for three touchdowns in the win, and the Texans held Indianapolis without a touchdown for the first time since 2024, according to the team's own schedule page. With no game this week, Houston's coaching staff continues extra preparation before hosting Baltimore in Week 12, with full broadcast and streaming information carried on the team's official site.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium (formerly Reliant Stadium), Houston. Venue still.

items.hed: New Astros manager Brad Ausmus has filled out most of his coaching staff, adding Nate Irving as assistant hitting coach this week after hiring Aaron Bates as hitting coach and J.P. Martinez as pitching coach last weekend
items.insight: Irving, most recently a hitting coach in the Mets' minor league system, will work alongside fellow new hire Bates; the Astros haven't yet announced a decision on holdover hitting coach Victor Rodriguez, who could still be retained. The moves follow last week's hiring of Bobby Wilson as bench coach and new general manager Randy Flores bringing in former Cardinals colleague Matt Bayer as assistant GM, as Houston continues the coaching-staff turnover that began with Joe Espada's departure at the end of last season.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Houston Rockets head home to face the Phoenix Suns in an NBA Cup group game Wednesday night at Toyota Center, looking to build on Monday's 116-104 win over the Los Angeles Clippers behind Kevin Durant's season-high 32 points
items.insight: The win over the Clippers opened a five-game Rockets homestand, with Durant's 32 points marking a season high; the full box score and shooting line remain on the league's official game page. Houston's next scheduled matchup, Wednesday's tip against Phoenix at Toyota Center, is part of the NBA's in-season Emirates NBA Cup group play, with broadcast information carried on the team's official schedule page.
